items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: So I was in the office with him this night, and he was saying, 'Kay, you got to let me have the ring

ctx.x: As a matter of fact, there's a funny story about it. Hal wanted to keep the place opened one more week, and he had given her an engagement ring that cost $6500, you know? So I was in the office with him this night, and he was saying, 'Kay, you got to let me have the ring, I think if I get off the nut this week, I really think I'll be able to stay open.' You know, and she says, 'I'm not gonna give you my ring, because ....' and I'm sitting there between them, you know, and so he says, 'Well, Lee, talk to her; see…
Ooh! And didn't get the ring?
